messages:
lucy: Heads up — targeting midnight UTC for the blue->green router tilt. Change window 00:00-01:00 UTC. Can everyone ack? :rocket:
max: ack from eng-releases. Canary at 1% for first 10m, then 10m at 5%, then 30% if stable. ops-runbook linked: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/tilt-evac
jamal: ops-oncall pinned to watch. I'll be in the room. @ops-oncall
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled by lucy for service 'router-edge' image=router:v3.4.2 start_ts=3580246910
diane: quick check — are we pinning session affinity to green before shift? Last time we had stickiness thundering herd
lucy: yes — session-affinity=true on green, cookie TTL 10m. We'll set affinity pin prior to any weight change.
max: command I'll run: ```curl -X POST https://infra-api/weights -d '{"router": "green", "weight": 1}'``` then ramp with `set-weight --service router --to <pct>`
jamal: add rolling fallback: if p95 > 600ms or 5xx rate > 0.5% for 5m -> rollback to blue. Ops monitors: latency-dashboard /dash/edge-p95
ops-oncall: I'll add an alert rule: name=tilt-p95-threshold expr=p95(edge_latency) > 600 for 5m
deploy-bot: deploy started: router:v3.4.2 on green pool (12 nodes). Logs: https://deploys/3580246910
lucy: starting 1% canary in 3m. @diane please verify session cookies look ok after the first user hits green
diane: watching cookie set header. Looks good :eyes:
max: after 10m, I'll run `set-weight --service router --to 5 --duration 10m` then `--to 30` if nominal
jamal: small note — can we set KV-cache warmup? runbook suggests `warmup-cache --service router --keys recent-qs`
lucy: done, kicked warmup. Also preloaded KV snapshot to green to avoid cold misses
ops-oncall: alerting: tilt-p95-threshold fired? not yet. I'll post in this thread if anything fires
deploy-bot: weight-change executed: router -> green 1% (actor=max) ts=3580246960
diane: saw a 502 spike for ~90s at 1% (3 events). Count seems small but noting it. :warning:
max: can you paste small sample logs?
diane: `curl -I https://edge/redwood` sample: HTTP/2 502 from proxy-pp-7 in green, upstream timeout 2002ms`
jamal: okay keep moving to 5% but watch 5xx and cache misses
deploy-bot: weight-change executed: router -> green 5% (actor=max) ts=3580246990
ops-oncall: p95=420ms, 5xx=0.12% — within thresholds
lucy: good. if at any point p95 > 600 or 5xx > 0.5% we stop and roll back. Everyone ready for 30%?
max: ready. I'll ramp to 30 over 5 minutes
deploy-bot: weight-change executed: router -> green 30% (actor=max) ts=3580247050
diane: at 30% p95=610ms spike, 5xx=0.6% — crossing thresholds, recommend pause and roll back to blue
jamal: +1 pause. Initiate rollback plan A: `set-weight --service router --to 0 --to_pool blue --immediate`
max: executing rollback now
deploy-bot: rollback executed: router -> green 0% (blue=100%) (actor=max) ts=3580247075
ops-oncall: alerts cleared, p95 back to 280ms, 5xx 0.02%
lucy: confirming rollback complete. We'll abort the rest of the midnight waves. Filing follow-up: root cause triage tomorrow 09:30 PT. Release notes updated: https://confluence/releases/edge-3.4.2 (note: rollback, session-affinity adjustments)
jamal: adding action items: increase KV pre-warm, add circuit-breaker for slow upstreams, and extend canary time to 20m next attempt
max: will add controlled gradual ramp script and a dry-run mode to simulate latency impact
diane: thanks all. ops-oncall — please move to postmortem channel when you have the preliminary logs :pray:
ops-oncall: will do. tagging @oncall-team and leaving handover notes
